address: 1 Mu 8, Chok Chai, Nakhon Ratchasima, 30190, Thailand
bio: Locals flock to Auntie Pleung's for Korat's quintessential noodle dish, Pad Mhee Kratok, served in its purest form – with a soft yet chewy noodle texture that requires no additional seasoning. Her tiny district shop also whips up award-winning spins on Pad Thai and papaya salad....
